AYANA SOLUNA VILLAS

Villa in Si Sunthon
HomeSaleAYANA SOLUNA VILLAS

Developer renders from the official AYANA Phuket website. Layouts and finishes may differ from the final product.

Project overview

AYANA SOLUNA VILLAS is a private pool villa development in the Si Sunthon area of Thalang, built by T.H. Group Phuket Co., Ltd. Listings describe a large green site of around 72 rai by a lake and surrounded by hills, with 3 to 5 bedroom villas that each have a private pool.

The same developer is behind AYANA Heights Seaview Residence and Kora Beach Resort Phuket. The official project reference is ayanaphuket.com/ayana-villas.

The official project page lists 62 villas on about 72 rai in Thalang. Type A is a garden-view villa of 221.1 sqm internal plus 129.8 sqm external space (350.9 sqm total) with a 10 m x 3.5 m pool. Completion dates differ between sources, so we show none. Prices are on request: message us on WhatsApp for the current price list.
